UI/UX DESIGN INTERN – INTERNSHIP DESCRIPTION The UI/UX Design Internship is designed for students who are passionate about creativity, technology, digital products, and user-centered design. This internship provides students with an opportunity to understand how professional digital products are planned, designed, tested, and improved to deliver better user experiences. Participants will gain practical exposure to the UI/UX design lifecycle while working on real-world projects and industry-oriented assignments. The internship focuses on developing both creative and analytical skills required to become a successful UI/UX designer. Students will learn how to understand user requirements, identify usability challenges, develop design solutions, create wireframes, design attractive user interfaces, build interactive prototypes, and validate their designs through usability testing. During the internship, participants will be introduced to the fundamentals of User Experience Design and User Interface Design. They will understand the difference between UX and UI and learn how both disciplines work together to create meaningful and effective digital experiences. Students will explore design thinking, user-centered design methodologies, information architecture, visual hierarchy, typography, color theory, accessibility, responsive design, and interaction design. A major component of the internship is user research. Interns will learn how to understand the target audience, identify user needs, analyze user behavior, and convert research findings into useful design insights. They may work with user personas, empathy maps, user journeys, and problem statements to understand the challenges faced by users. This process will help students develop a structured approach to solving design problems rather than relying only on visual creativity. Participants will also gain practical experience in creating user flows and information architecture. They will learn how to organize content and features in a logical manner so that users can easily navigate websites and applications. Students will create low-fidelity wireframes to establish the basic structure and functionality of digital products before moving into detailed visual designs. The internship provides hands-on exposure to UI design principles. Students will learn how to create clean, modern, consistent, and visually appealing interfaces for websites, mobile applications, dashboards, landing pages, and other digital products. They will work with typography, color palettes, spacing, grids, icons, images, buttons, forms, cards, navigation elements, and other interface components. Participants will be introduced to industry-standard design and prototyping tools such as Figma. They will learn how to create design screens, reusable components, interactive prototypes, and basic design systems.
